supporting_observations.claim: Repeated svc-render authentication failures occur on FILE-NWD-01 at roughly one-minute intervals, including immediately before and after 13:40 UTC; the records show wrong-password status.
The failures identify FILE-NWD-01 as the workstation and show the same source IP, 10.40.20.20, and LSASS process, rather than indicating attempts from an unrelated host.

The observed pattern is consistent with the supplied change calendar and service inventory: svc-render's password was scheduled to rotate at 13:30, its job re-authenticates each run, and the job must be updated manually. The failures begin just after the rotation and continue at approximately the job's stated cadence.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied authentication records end at 13:46 UTC, so they do not cover the remainder of the requested window through 14:20 UTC.
The records show authentication failures, but do not establish whether the RenderQueue job was subsequently updated or whether authentication later succeeded.
The failure records identify LSASS as the process; they do not identify the specific service or application component that initiated each authentication.
claims_not_established: Whether any successful svc-render authentication occurred after the supplied records.
Whether the scheduled password rotation was completed as planned and when the RenderQueue job's stored credential was updated.
Whether any other activity on FILE-NWD-01 occurred during the rest of the review window.
